|errata_history=Versions of [[Found Someone You Have (V)]] in [[Virtual Set 5: A Dark Time]], in date order (2 versions). Slip texts are quoted as printed: ▼ and ▲ are the slips' arrow icons (deploy from / take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle), and the immunity and pilot icons are the ones explained in each sheet's icon key (see [[Virtual card icons]]). Found while adding the original pre-Remaster slips (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[Found Someone You Have (V) (Virtual Set 5)]]): first release sheet “Virtual Set #5” (Players Committee, 30 May 2003; tournament legal 6 June 2003), page 1, slip 7 — [https://web.archive.org/web/20030801181811/http://www.theforce.net/ccg/vcards/SWCCGVirtualSet5.pdf PDF on theforce.net] linked from the [https://web.archive.org/web/20030603182926/http://swccgpc.com:80/interior.htm PC news post of 30 May 2003] (Internet Archive capture of the PDF, 1 August 2003; PDF dated 30–31 May 2003): “Find one of your missing characters. OR Retrieve the top character of your Lost Pile into hand.” The slip is the old pre-template slip the Committee used before its December 2006 Remaster: the Decipher-style lower half with the slip mark “5•7” at bottom right and no expansion icon.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Remaster sheet (official text as of 4 December 2006; [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024154714/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards5.pdf Internet Archive capture of 24 October 2007], slip 7), in the Committee's Remaster template: “Find one of your missing characters. OR Retrieve the topmost character of your Lost Pile into hand.” These words were first published on the revised sheet of 11 June 2003 (PDF dated 11 June 2003; still hosted by the Players Committee at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards5.pdf res.starwarsccg.org], page 1, slip 7), on the old pre-Remaster slip ([[:File:OVS5-07-Found_Someone_You_Have-original-slip-2003-06-11.png]], shown on this page as an additional image: “Original slip, 11 June 2003”); the Remaster repeats them word for word in the new template. '''What changed''' from the original: “top” became “topmost”. This is the current text of the Virtual Original card.
